home.diagnostic.title: How learning begins
home.diagnostic.step1.title: Request
home.diagnostic.step1.text: Fill in a short form: the subject, the grade and what your child needs help with.
home.diagnostic.step2.title: Assessment
home.diagnostic.step2.text: In a 30-minute online meeting the teacher reviews your child’s knowledge in full and sees their strengths and main gaps.
home.diagnostic.step3.title: Recommendation
home.diagnostic.step3.text: We go through the results with you and suggest a programme, format and lesson frequency that suit your child.
home.formats.title: Lesson formats
home.formats.group.title: Group
home.formats.group.text: 3–6 students at the same level. A good fit for steady work on the school curriculum or bagrut preparation.
home.formats.individual.title: One to one
home.formats.individual.text: One to one with a teacher. A good fit for working through a hard topic, closing specific gaps or preparing for a test.
